answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the quartz scores zero and the identity stops earning. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed echo of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. So a haven of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1lrvo.
